classifications.label: GRT
classifications.reason: LIRA Medical Group uses GRT as a catalogue section/brand claim, but does not identify a legal manufacturer or publish an attributable SKU catalogue; search results for dental GRT do not establish that it is GDT Implants, so the names must not be merged.

classifications.label: Johnson & Johnson
classifications.reason: The current Denti.kz brand filter has no exact Johnson & Johnson entry. A conglomerate name without a current dental SKU source cannot generate a canonical dental catalogue.

classifications.label: MustDent
classifications.reason: MustDent is a Kazakhstan wholesale legal entity/importer. The current Denti.kz brand filter has no exact MustDent entry, and supplier catalogue paths must not be converted into a manufacturer brand.

classifications.label: Medexim
classifications.reason: Medexim's dental compressor pages explicitly identify EKOM equipment. EKOM is already represented as the manufacturer brand, so duplicating the same products under Medexim would create false brand cards.

classifications.label: Nuvo
classifications.reason: The Kazakhstan observation is a Nuvo surgical suit listing. It does not establish a dental manufacturer identity or a standalone manufacturer SKU catalogue.

classifications.label: Ordamed
classifications.reason: Ordamed is a Kazakhstan medical equipment distributor/company. Products must be attributed to their actual manufacturers instead of creating an Ordamed manufacturer catalogue.

classifications.label: Hummer-Pak
classifications.reason: The Kazakhstan listing identifies Hummer-Pak and article СКТ-5, but no attributable legal manufacturer or current official SKU catalogue could be verified. The exact observed card remains available for supplier-price matching and manual identity review; no additional cards are invented.

classifications.label: TORNADO
classifications.reason: TORNADO is an official compressor product line of Dürr Dental, not a separate manufacturer brand. Existing Kazakhstan observations are preserved and reconciled against the structured Dürr Dental catalogue instead of creating duplicate brand cards.
